title: I vear thee beest a gert vool
html_source: “I fear you are a great fool”

anchor.text: I vear thee beest a gert vool
anchor.prefix: to be believed. Your starving eyes and allbeplastered neck you stole my heart, O gluepot. Sir? Spud again the rheumatiz? All poppycock, you'll scuse me saying. For the hoi polloi.
anchor.suffix: . Well, doc? Back fro Lapland? Your corporosity sagaciating O K? How's the squaws and papooses? Womanbody after going on the straw? Stand and deliver. Password. There's hair. Ours
